correctness.rationale: For each n=3,...,16, independently enumerated the cyclic binary strings avoiding both 11 and 000, checked all candidate shattered fixed vertex subsets, and solved the complete finite Littlestone minimax recurrence over version-space bitsets. Reproduced all 14 rows, counts 39 and 90 at n=13,16, VC values 4 and 5 and adaptive values 5 and 6. The recurrence strictly descends on smaller nonempty hypothesis sets, proving termination and exhaustive upper/lower bounds. Product maximal-independent-set families on disjoint components give additive VC; standard optimal-online-mistake characterization gives additive Ldim. No inference for connected n>16.
residual_risks: The finite exhaustive calculation applies to precisely 3<=n<=16; the product consequence relies on an independently explained Ldim additivity theorem rather than computing arbitrarily many components.

value.rationale: Natural first finite transition between static and adaptive shattering for canonical graph-solution memberships: C13 is the smallest cycle with gap, gap disappears at C14/C15 then returns C16. Disjoint 2-regular graph unions force an unbounded separation, so the sharp finite boundary is mathematically motivated and not just a convenience table.
residual_risks: The finite table is not an all-cycle classification; the unbounded family is disconnected.

final_claim: For maximal-independent-set membership on ordinary C_n, exact VC and Littlestone values are given for 3<=n<=16; their first strict gap is (4,5) at n=13, recurs (5,6) at n=16, and disjoint copies of C13 give dimensions 4s and 5s.
